'''Oriol Tomas Valls''' (born 1947 in Barcelona, Spain) is a [[physics]] professor at the [[University of Minnesota]].<ref name=umnpage>{{cite web |url=http://www.physics.umn.edu/people/otvalls.html |title=Oriol T. Valls |author= |date= |work=[[University of Minnesota]] |accessdate=22 July 2012}}</ref> After obtaining  his 
BSc in Physics at the [[University of Barcelona]] he earned a PhD at [[Brown University]], in 1976. 
After a postdoctoral position at the [[University of Chicago]] he held a Miller Fellowship at 
the [[University of California Berkeley]] before joining the [[University of Minnesota]] faculty. He specializes in Condensed Matter Theory. He is an [[American Physical Society]] fellow since 1998<ref>{{cite web|title=APS Fellow Archive|website=American Physical Society|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=1998&unit_id=&institution=University+of+Minnesota}} (search on year=1998 and institution=University of Minnesota)</ref> and has won the APS Outstanding Referee Award.<ref name=umnpage /> From 2016 he has also been the Editor of the Newsletter published by the Forum of Physics and Society of the [[American Physical Society]]
